workstreams.name: Claims organization today
workstreams.answers: How is the claims department organized today, in structure, roles and handoffs?
activities: Walk through claims steps with the people who do the work
Map structure, roles and handoffs as they run today
Collect operational data on claims volumes and workload

workstreams.name: Leaders' needs for claims
workstreams.answers: What do the Chief Operating Officer and Head of Claims need the new organization to fix and keep?
activities: Interview the Chief Operating Officer and Head of Claims
Interview claims staff on what works and what does not
Record what the new organization must fix and must keep

workstreams.name: Problem areas and criteria
workstreams.answers: Which problem areas in claims structure, roles and handoffs, and which design criteria, go into the Design phase?
activities: Rank problem areas using the mapping, interviews and data
Draft design criteria and agree them with the leaders
Propose which problem areas the Design phase takes forward

workstreams.name: Claims model options
workstreams.answers: Which options for claims structure, roles and handoffs should be compared, and against which design criteria?
activities: Draft options for claims structure, roles and handoffs
Compare the options against the agreed design criteria
Present the options at the design workshop for a choice

workstreams.name: Target claims organization
workstreams.answers: What does the chosen target claims organization look like in structure, roles, handoffs and governance?
activities: Detail structure, roles and governance of the chosen model
Design the handoffs between claims roles
Detail the design with the leaders of each claims unit

workstreams.name: Claims transition plan
workstreams.answers: What transition does the target claims organization need, and in what order do the changes happen?
activities: Identify what changes for each role and handoff
Sequence the changes needed to reach the target model
Test the sequence with the Head of Claims

workstreams.name: Target model sign-off
workstreams.answers: What must the executive committee see to approve the target claims organization?
activities: Review the target model and plan with both leaders
Resolve review comments in the design and plan
Assemble the material for executive committee approval
